blocks.source: ワイルドアームズ2
blocks.translation: Wild Arms 2

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Content / Story

blocks.source: 主人公はARMSという部隊に所属し、悪の組織オデッサと戦う。正義の英雄が悪の組織と戦うという実に王道な構成であるが、物語の中でそれに留まらないテーマが示される。
blocks.translation: The protagonist belongs to a unit called ARMS and fights the evil organization Odessa. It is a very traditional setup in which a righteous hero fights an evil organization, but the story presents themes that go beyond that.

blocks.source: この作品を語る際に必ず話題に上がるのはラストバトルの演出の良さ。そこに到るまでのストーリーとマッチして、プレイヤーに感動をもたらすことは間違いない。
blocks.translation: What always comes up when discussing this game is how well the final battle is presented. It matches the story leading up to it and is sure to move the player.

blocks.source: 後、忘れてはならないのトカ＆ゲーの存在。比較的シリアスな本作の中でギャグキャラクターとして抜群の存在感を発揮する。本作主人公のアシュレーはどちらかというと真面目で地味なキャラクターであるが、彼らとの会話では意外なツッコミの才能を見せることになる。
blocks.translation: Also, we mustn't forget Toka & Gea. They have an outstanding presence as comedic characters in this relatively serious game. The protagonist, Ashley, is a rather serious and unassuming character, but in conversations with them, he reveals an unexpected talent for witty retorts.

blocks.source: 本編に十分な質量があるのに、サブイベントも豊富。ダンジョンの謎解きには非常に力が入っている。
blocks.translation: Despite the main story having plenty of substance, there are also many side events. Considerable effort has gone into the dungeon puzzles.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: このシリーズの特徴として挙げられるのが謎解きの多いダンジョン。ゼルダの伝説のようなものだと思ってもらえれば。謎解きの完成度もゼルダに負けないクオリティ。ただ、この時間がかかる謎解き系ダンジョンとストーリー主導型のＲＰＧの相性がいいかと言われると、ちょっと微妙かも……。
blocks.translation: One of this series' defining features is its puzzle-filled dungeons. Think of something like The Legend of Zelda. The puzzles are of a quality that can hold its own against Zelda's. However, when it comes to whether these time-consuming puzzle dungeons are a good fit for a story-driven RPG, the answer may be a little questionable...

blocks.source: 作品の全体的な完成度と比較すると、戦闘は何かと物足りない。具体的に言うと……。
blocks.translation: Compared to the game's overall level of polish, the battles leave something to be desired. Specifically...

blocks.source: 長いロード時間。戦闘開始までに１０秒程度。
blocks.translation: Long loading times. It takes about 10 seconds to start a battle.

blocks.source: もっさりした演出。通常攻撃・特技いずれも爽快感に欠ける。
blocks.translation: Sluggish presentation. Both normal attacks and Techs lack a satisfying impact.

blocks.source: 味方３人、敵３体が同時出現数の限界。
blocks.translation: The limit for simultaneous appearances is three allies and three enemies.

blocks.source: ＤＱ的なオーソドックスなターン制。
blocks.translation: A conventional, Dragon Quest-style turn-based system.

blocks.source: ほとんどの雑魚が戦士系キャラクターの通常攻撃１発で死ぬ。
blocks.translation: Most weaker enemies die from a single normal attack by a warrior-type character.

blocks.source: 特技は命中率が低く使いにくい。効率を考えると通常攻撃の方がマシだったり……。
blocks.translation: Techs have low accuracy and are difficult to use. When considering efficiency, normal attacks are sometimes better...

blocks.source: しょぼめの効果音。特に回復の効果音は謎。
blocks.translation: rather underwhelming sound effects. The healing sound effect in particular is a mystery.

blocks.source: グラフィックはＰＳ初期の粗いポリゴン。
blocks.translation: The graphics use rough polygons typical of the early days of the PS.

blocks.source: まだ救いなのは敵が無駄にしぶとくないこと。エンカウントキャンセルによって、ザコ戦闘を発生前にキャンセルできること、加えて元々のエンカウント率もそれほど高くないこと。このお陰で、戦闘が合わなくても何とか最後まで進めることができる。
blocks.translation: One saving grace is that the enemies are not needlessly durable. Encounters with weaker enemies can be canceled before they occur using Encounter Cancel, and the original encounter rate is not particularly high to begin with. Thanks to this, even if the battles are not to your liking, you can somehow make it to the end.

blocks.source: 戦闘さえもっと面白ければ、同時期のＦＦなみに人にお勧めできるゲームになりそうなのだけど……。
blocks.translation: If only the battles were more entertaining, this could have been a game I could recommend to people as highly as the Final Fantasy games from the same period...

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: マップはＤＱ７などと同じく２Ｄ色の強い３Ｄ。キャラクターは２Ｄ。戦闘では粗いポリゴンバリバリの３Ｄ。というようにこの時代らしい組み合わせ。戦闘の迫力はＦＦ７などと比べるとさすがに劣る。無理せずにフィールドと同じようなちびキャラで良かったと思うけれど、でも当時としては挑戦する価値があったのかも……。
blocks.translation: Like Dragon Quest VII, the maps are 3D with a strong 2D feel. The characters are 2D. Battles use aggressively rough polygonal 3D. It is a combination very much of its era. The battles are understandably less impressive than those in Final Fantasy VII and similar games. I think it would have been fine to use chibi characters like those on the field without overreaching, but perhaps it was worth taking on the challenge at the time...

blocks.source: ゲーム部分のグラフィックは見劣りするのだけど、オープニングアニメーションの質は別格。歌の良さもあって、ゲームを起動するたびに毎回見たくなるほど。後半（Disc2）になると、オープニングアニメーションと歌が一新されるのも凝っている。
blocks.translation: The in-game graphics look dated, but the opening animation is in a class of its own. Combined with how good the song is, it makes you want to watch it every time you start the game. It is also an elaborate touch that the opening animation and song are completely revamped in the latter half (Disc2).

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: オープニングアニメーション。ラストバトル。フィールドと良い曲だらけ。通常戦闘曲だけはシリーズの中では地味めな気がするけれど悪くはない。どうでもいいけど個人的に作曲者として、なるけみちこ女史には影響を受けてます。
blocks.translation: The opening animation. The final battle. The field. It is full of great music. The normal battle theme feels somewhat understated compared to the rest of the series, but it is not bad. Not that it matters, but speaking personally as a composer, I have been influenced by Michiko Naruke.
